wholeGoal.title: Reduzierende Kohlenhydrate nachweisen und erklären
wholeGoal.description: Die lernende Person kann kontrollierte Fehling- beziehungsweise in der Lehrplanroute verlangte Benedict-Nachweise durchführen, auswerten und positive sowie negative Kohlenhydratbefunde durch zugängliche Carbonylformen und die Verknüpfung anomerer Zentren erklären.
wholeGoal.descriptionEn: The learner can carry out and evaluate controlled Fehling assays, or Benedict assays required by the curriculum route, and explain positive and negative carbohydrate results through accessible carbonyl forms and anomeric-centre linkages.

records.originalHoldStatus: The original universal-fructose requirement is resolved for the exact corrected successor. The old profile/cases and own original HOLD remain unchanged.

wholeCaseFindings.finding: The complete controlled Fehling glucose/sucrose/water task, volume/reagent/time/temperature instructions, observation requirement and structural explanation are preserved. An actual submitted record is still required for real learner execution; expected colors remain predictions.

The corrected whole Fehling transfer still requires independently performed maltose testing with valid fresh controls and actual records, comparing a free anomeric centre with sucrose linking both centres. Full task, material, expected performance and full-credit evidence now condition fructose/enediol work on a literally appropriate curriculum/course route. HE-basic completion no longer depends on that advanced chemistry.
wholeCaseFindings.scientificReason: Maltose with a free anomeric centre can access a reducing carbonyl form; sucrose binds both anomeric centres. A controlled positive copper result indicates reducing behaviour under the selected method conditions, not unique glucose identity or a numerical concentration. The new branch keeps a chemically changed transfer, rather than simply dropping the second expectation.

wholeCaseFindings.finding: The complete corrected Benedict material still supplies authorised reagent, glucose/sucrose/maltose/water,2mL+2mL,5min80°C, separate pipettes, controls, records and deviation handling. Fructose is supplied only for the explicitly relevant extension route. The actual five-point rubric retains execution, controls, structural transfer, Cu(II)/Cu(I) redox and inference limits, while making fructose rearrangement compulsory only in that route.
wholeCaseFindings.scientificReason: The required practical acquisition and independent maltose/disaccharide reasoning remain observable. Neither a synthetic model response nor the predicted precipitate is represented as the learner having carried out the assay.

records.wholeRawProfileFit: Mandatory aspect-1 and aspect-2 plus fresh independent transfer/variation rules remain. New aspect-2 and source-required-assay/evidence-not-run-quota axes consistently distinguish assay-method route from ketose-extension scope. A Benedict choice alone is no longer treated as proof that fructose tautomerism is required.
records.routeBoundary: The retained fructose/enediol-to-aldose teaching model is an explicit appropriate-route extension. It is not certified as an exhaustive elementary mechanism, made universal to every basic route, or used to infer all other jurisdictions were reviewed. The original HE basic/elevated distinction remains the source boundary.
records.completionRule: The corrected cases and raw-profile axes explicitly permit rich coherent independently performed work with genuine distinct transfer to cover several requirements. They forbid an additional run solely to meet a fixed quota after adequate evidence. The unchanged aspect-1 historical Doppellauf/two-run wording is an available workflow reference; the explicit current whole-case and axis rules prevent it being used as a compulsory extra-run quota.
remainingBoundaries: No observed learner execution, actual observations or HumanTrial are supplied.
A future route must actually be resolved against its literal source; no global track/method equivalence is inferred.
Existing Normal profile fingerprints and bindings are not refreshed or granted by this scientific judgment.

wholeGoal.title: Aminosäuren über Säure-Base-Verhalten erklären
wholeGoal.titleEn: Explain amino acids through acid-base behaviour
wholeGoal.description: Die lernende Person kann pH-abhängige Ladungszustände einfacher Aminosäuren und ihr amphoteres Verhalten im Donator-Akzeptor-Konzept anhand von Strukturformeln erklären.
wholeGoal.descriptionEn: The learner can explain pH-dependent charge states and amphoteric behaviour of simple amino acids using donor-acceptor concepts and structural formulas.

resourceLinks.altText: Drei vereinfachte dominante Glycinformen bei pH2, pH6 und pH12 tragen die Gesamtladungen +1,0 und −1. Das Zwitterion in der Mitte zeigt gleichzeitig NH3+ und COO−.

records.originalHoldStatus: The original mandatory cathode/electric-migration performance is resolved in the exact corrected whole case-2, expected performance, full-credit evidence and mandatory aspect-2. Optional migration is separately located and no longer a charge-goal completion condition.

wholeCaseFindings.finding: The supplied glycine pKa values and pH1/6/12 dominant structures remain. Formal net charges+1,0,−1, internal zwitterion charges and donor/acceptor explanations are scientifically coherent task-model evidence.

The corrected complete case retains all lysine ionisable groups and supplied2.2/9.0/10.5 pKa values. AtpH7, one predominantly COO− and two predominantly NH3+ groups give dominant formal net+1, compared with predominantly net0 glycine. It additionally requires explaining the connecting proton gain/loss, so independent acid/base transfer is preserved.
wholeCaseFindings.scientificLimits: Dominant is explicitly distinguished from exclusive; no recall of numerical constants is demanded. The unchanged-amino-acid-identity phrase is read as retention of the amino-acid heavy-atom framework, not a claim that proton count or every N−H/O−H bond is unchanged.
wholeCaseFindings.optionalExtension: The negative-electrode migration is labelled optional outside this goal. Under a stated suitable field it is a valid later application, not required acid/base evidence.

newRemainingDefect.exactProblemDe: Vorgegebene Sollfarben oder ein Plan ersetzen die geforderte echte Durchführung nicht.
newRemainingDefect.exactProblemEn: Predicted colours or a plan do not replace the required actual execution.
newRemainingDefect.reason: This newly added e9-specific axis imports color/experimental-execution language into a whole goal and compulsory case pair that require structural protonation/charge reasoning. Its definite required actual execution can be read as a new laboratory obligation. The same axis says no extra operation, so the full raw profile is internally ambiguous even though the corrected cases and old cathode issue are sound.
newRemainingDefect.boundedVerdict: This is a new operator-scope ambiguity in the successor raw profile, not a rejection of valid charge science or a resurrection of the old cathode HOLD.

records.smallestRemedy: Change only this new e9 variation axis to require independently produced structural forms, charge sums, proton-donor/acceptor reasoning and genuine added-ionisable-group transfer, explicitly with no laboratory execution or electrophoresis duty for this goal. Preserve both corrected whole e9 cases, all1d2e material, required aspect IDs, variation/transfer rules and the no-extra-quota principle. No new case or numerical data are needed.
records.completionRule: Rich coherent independent structural reasoning with actual fresh transfer can satisfy the acid/base target. The generic no-extra-run principle must not introduce a run requirement where the whole goal has no experimental operator.
remainingBoundaries: The two e9 whole-case designs are scientifically usable as E1 content; the whole corrected raw-profile grant stays open only at the identified new axis.
No actual experiment, electrophoresis, learner result, human acceptance or global source release is inferred.

oldSourceAndHoldPreservation: The original audit7 payloads and the primary PDF/source-extraction references are independently verified unchanged. Original Holds remain truthful for original whole profiles/cases.
